audience: sales, service and marketing teams that keep their records in Dynamics 365 CRM

useCases.title: Explore custom tables and their columns
useCases.text: List the Dataverse tables with their entity set names. Read the columns of one table, including its primary name column.

useCases.title: Find records with a filter
useCases.text: List rows of a table with an OData filter, ordering and column selection. Open one record by its id to read it.

useCases.title: Run a FetchXML query with joins
useCases.text: Run a FetchXML query for joins, aggregates and link-entities. Keep the query under about 4000 characters. Read the table columns first.

useCases.title: Create a record in a table
useCases.text: Create one record in a table, such as a contact. The created row comes back in the reply.

useCases.title: Update one existing record
useCases.text: Update the columns you pass on one record. The tool never creates a row: an unknown id returns an error.
